label: AutoMod
tagline: Your blocklists first, then a panel of AI models on anything uncertain.
description: AutoMod checks every chat message against the rules below before anything else: your blocked terms, adult, slur and hate lists, spam phrases, blocked or IP-grabber sites, blocked accounts and the all-links switch. A message that matches one is removed. Anything those rules do not settle goes to a panel of AI models that score toxicity and hate in context. That panel is still learning on live chat: it records what it would do but never removes, times out or bans on its own, so borderline calls stay with your human mods.

block_terms.label: Blocked terms
block_terms.help: Words or phrases to remove in your channel. Separate with commas or new lines. Matched as whole words, ignoring case.

nsfw_terms.label: Adult terms
nsfw_terms.help: Sexual or adult words to remove on sight. Separate with commas or new lines.

slur_terms.label: Slurs
slur_terms.help: Slurs your channel never wants to see. Separate with commas or new lines.

racism_terms.label: Hate terms
racism_terms.help: Racist or hateful words and phrases to remove on sight. Separate with commas or new lines.

spam_phrases.label: Spam phrases
spam_phrases.help: Phrases only spammers post, like follower or viewer sales pitches. Separate with commas or new lines.

block_links.label: Block all links
block_links.help: Removes every message that contains a link, including bare domains like example.com. Off by default.

blocked_domains.label: Blocked sites
blocked_domains.help: Removes links to these sites and all their subdomains. Enter bare domains like example.com, without https:// or a path.

ip_logger_domains.label: IP-grabber sites
ip_logger_domains.help: IP-logger or tracking sites to remove. Enter bare domains like grabify.link.

blocked_accounts.label: Blocked accounts
blocked_accounts.help: Twitch user IDs (numbers, not usernames) whose messages are always removed. Separate with commas or new lines.
